# Echogarden browser subset

Source: Echogarden 3.4.0, https://github.com/echogarden-project/echogarden . WhisperSTT.js SHA256 6930b7301ec7253f73437471088994e6b60b21eb8a1e4f28156208a30d3ad9b3. License: MIT (LICENSE).

Whisper methods retained: recognize, align, decodeTokens, token timeline and cross-attention DTW, token conversion and suppression; tables/defaults. Native context, filesystem tokenizer loading, language detection and mel conversion removed. Browser helper adapters replace logging, segmentation, compression (unused with fixed infinite repetition threshold), deterministic top-1 sampling and yields. VectorMath, MedianFilter and windowed DTW are upstream source with imports removed. Decoder ceiling is 448, matching the old generated Worker decoder; Node recognition default 220 stays unchanged. English/non-CJK word patterns are precompiled from @echogarden/text-segmentation 0.8.1. Japanese/Chinese segmentation uses Intl.Segmenter; Japanese middle-dot compounds are merged before fast natural spacing. Full supplied 春泥棒 and SUNEO-ISM lyric preprocessing matches pinned upstream; arbitrary Japanese morphological/punctuation boundaries are not claimed equivalent to Kuromoji. Refresh is explicit build tooling; no runtime source extraction.
